test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ascent
solution: The correct answer is '**Descent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Ascent**' is '**Descent**'. • **Ascent**: the act of climbing or going up. (चढ़ाव, आरोहण) • *Example: the **ascent** of Mt Everest...* • **Descent**: a movement down to a lower place. (उतार, अवरोहण) • *Example: The pilot informed us that we were about to begin our **descent**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Descent.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Resent**: to feel angry about something because you think it is unfair. [(अनुचित प्रतीत होने के कारण) किसी बात का बुरा मानना या पर नाराज़ होना] • **Patent**: clear; obvious. (स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़; प्रकट, प्रत्‍यक्ष) • **Present**: existing or happening now. (वर्तमान, मौजूदा, इस समय का) 171:T583, The correct answer is **'is quite too'.**
